title: Alaska's Marine Highway
direction: Sails south on the ferry mainline from Skagway, at the head of the Inside Passage, through Southeast Alaska's island towns and down the British Columbia coast to Bellingham, Washington.

stretches.title: Down Lynn Canal
stretches.line: From the head of the Inside Passage past Haines to Alaska's capital.

stretches.title: The island towns
stretches.line: South through the islands to the harbour towns of Petersburg and Wrangell.

stretches.title: On to Ketchikan
stretches.line: The last Alaska port before the long run south.

stretches.title: The long run south
stretches.line: Along the British Columbia coast to Washington.
